sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Congested. Scalp feels tight; head feels as
if bound ; burning in eyes ; buzzing in car.s.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chill all over; worse in bed at night. Sen-
sitive to cold trade-winds on Pacific Coast. General
sore and bruised feeling; nausea and retching.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Wrinkled like a washerwoman’s. Scalp feels
tight, as if drawn together by India-rubber.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Increase of appetite. — [10.] Ructus. — Regurgitations. —
Waterbrash.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text: Flatus. — Slight pain, relieved by pressure.

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Several loose stools a day. — * Constipation. — Hard, knotty
morning stool.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Alleviating a catarrh, produced by influenza.

General Symptoms. — That kind of pain in head and fingers which
is concomitant with the attacks of intermittent fever.

Sleep and Dreams. — [20.] Sleeplessness (from 1st trit.).

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Chills repeatedly, down the spine, and all over, especially in
bed, at night. — Heat in whole body ; I could bear, after the proving, the
cool trade-wind, usually setting in, in San Francisco, in the afternoon,
better than before.

Conditions. — Aggravation. — (Morning), Hard stool. — (Night), In
bed, chills.

Amelioration. — (Pressure), Pain in abdomen.

CANNA.

Canna glauca, Linn. Nat. order, Cannacese. Common (Brazilian) name,
Imbiri. Preparation, Tincture of the leaves (Mure).

Authority. Mure, Pathogenesie Brasilienne (under the name of Canna
" angustifolia ").
